about: The Cells' own looks: dogs, cats and horned beasts, one for each Cell named after one.

pieces.name: pupper
pieces.about: A puppy's hood: brown, a white blaze down the forehead, and long dark floppy ears hanging down both sides.

pieces.name: doggo
pieces.about: A black-and-tan dog's hood: big upright ears, a black cap coming to a point on the brow, and tan cheeks.

pieces.name: cheems
pieces.about: A shiba's hood: a wide round orange head with small rounded ears, a cream dot over each eye and big cream cheeks.

pieces.name: curl
pieces.about: A shiba's tail curled tight into a ring at its hip, cream on the inside.

pieces.name: bork
pieces.about: A husky's hood: a grey cap over a white mask, tall pointed ears, and a pale blue mark over each eye.

pieces.name: dingo
pieces.about: A dingo's hood: lean and sandy, with tall narrow ears standing close together.

pieces.name: dingotail
pieces.about: A dingo's straight tail swung out to one side, sandy with a white tip.

pieces.name: puma
pieces.about: A puma's hood: lean and tawny, with blunt ears dark on the back, a cream brow and white whiskers out at each cheek.

pieces.name: pumatail
pieces.about: A puma's long tail wrapped round its feet, the dark tip curling up at one side.

pieces.name: panther
pieces.about: A black panther's hood: sleek charcoal with small pointed ears, two yellow eyes on its brow and a white whisker at each cheek.

pieces.name: panthertail
pieces.about: A panther's long black tail raised behind it, hooked over at the tip.

pieces.name: badger
pieces.about: A badger's hood: white, with two bold black stripes running from the brow over the top to small white-tipped ears.

pieces.name: bison
pieces.about: A bison's woolly cap: dark brown, a high shaggy hump, a ragged fringe over the brow and two short curved horns.

pieces.name: yak
pieces.about: A yak's head of hair: long shaggy charcoal hair hanging to the ground at both sides of the face, a forelock, and wide upswept horns.

pieces.name: moose
pieces.about: A moose's antlers: two broad flat palms with short tines along the top, on a brown cap with a small ear under each.

pieces.name: llama
pieces.about: A llama's woolly hood in cream: tall banana-shaped ears curving in at the tips, and a white wool topknot between them.

pieces.name: alpaca
pieces.about: An alpaca's fleece: a big round caramel bouffant, curly as a cloud, a fringe hanging at its front edge and a small ear at each side.

pieces.name: meowingtons
pieces.about: A black top hat with a crimson band, and two white cat ears poking up through its brim.

pieces.name: monocle
pieces.about: A gold monocle over one eye, its chain hanging down.

pieces.name: purrito
pieces.about: A grey tabby's cap: small pointed ears, pink inside, and three tabby stripes on the forehead.

collar.about: A red dog collar round the neck, a brass tag hanging from it.

collar-sky.about: The dog collar in sky blue, with its brass tag.

collar-lime.about: The dog collar in lime, with its brass tag.

tortilla.about: A flour tortilla wrapped round the body like a blanket, up to the cheeks, toasted in flecks, with a band of foil at its base.

tortilla-spinach.about: The tortilla blanket in spinach green, with a band of foil at its base.

tortilla-corn.about: The tortilla blanket in blue corn, with a band of foil at its base.
